title: Specialty coffee and brewing spaces in Kochi
description: Find specialty coffee cafés, coffee carts and brewing education spaces around Kochi, with map searches and sources.
intro: A source-linked guide to Kochi places with a documented connection to specialty coffee or coffee education. Find a café for a cup, a cart for coffee on the go, or a space to learn brewing. This is not a ranking or a certification of coffee quality. Menus and hours can change; map links are searches, so check the location and contact the place before visiting.

entries.name: 90Million Coffee
entries.description: The café says it serves specialty Arabica, including Ratnagiri Estate beans, and manual brews alongside baked goods.
entries.address: 1st Floor, Edward Square, Stadium Link Road, Kathrikadavu, Kaloor, Kochi

entries.name: Cafe Addict Kochi
entries.description: A café and art space that describes its coffee as specialty-focused. Its Kochi menu also lists several cold brews.

entries.name: Cafficana Kochi
entries.description: Local coffee drinkers have mentioned V60, Chemex and siphon here. These are visitor reports, so check what is currently available before going.

entries.name: Coz Coffee
entries.description: A coffee-led café with food and a broad drinks menu. A local visitor has mentioned pour-over coffee; check what is available before visiting.
entries.address: 841/E2, South Panampilly Nagar Road, Cheriyakadavanthra, Kochi 682015

entries.name: Epic Poetry Café & Patisserie
entries.description: The café describes serving single-estate coffee, including espresso and pour-over, with food and patisserie.
entries.address: Opposite metro pillar 841, Janatha Junction, Vyttila, Kochi 682019

entries.name: Kaapi Street
entries.description: A specialty-coffee cart whose website features espresso and cold-brew drinks. Check its current service before making a special trip.

entries.name: Kapiberry Coffee Academy
entries.description: Kapiberry lists hands-on barista training and café startup programmes. This is a training space, not a confirmed walk-in café; contact the academy to confirm current courses and the directory-listed address before visiting.

entries.name: Kochi Kapital Kafe
entries.description: The café lists specialty pour-over coffee among its drinks, alongside a broader food menu.
entries.address: Peter Celli Street, Fort Nagar, Fort Kochi, Kochi

entries.name: Nosh Haus | Arrow Mark
entries.description: Local reporting describes this Jew Town coffee spot serving artisanal coffees, including barrel-aged and fermented beans. Ask what beans and brews are currently available.
entries.address: Arrow Mark, Jew Town Road, Mattancherry, Kochi 682002

entries.name: Pour Over Lab
entries.description: A coffee learning and experience space offering pour-over, AeroPress and espresso workshops. Contact the lab about sessions and visiting; it is not listed here as a walk-in café.

entries.name: Thara Coffee Caravan
entries.description: Thara describes its caravan as a mobile coffee outlet. It has been reported on KP Vallon Road, but mobile locations can change; confirm where it is operating before travelling.
entries.address: KP Vallon Road, Indira Nagar, Kadavanthra, Kochi

entries.name: The Brew School
entries.description: A professional training school with a barista skills course. Contact the school about courses and visits; it is not listed here as a walk-in café.
entries.address: 2nd Floor, Daffodils, KP Vallon Road, Giri Nagar, Kadavanthra, Ernakulam 682020

entries.name: Third Wave Coffee — Kakkanad
entries.description: The specialty-coffee chain lists this branch at Noel Focus Mall in Chittethukara. Its Kochi cafés offer coffee and food; check the branch menu for current brews.
entries.address: Unit 2, Door 18/1155, Ground Floor, Noel Focus Mall, Seaport–Airport Road, CSEZ, Chittethukara, Kakkanad, Kochi

entries.name: Third Wave Coffee — Panampilly Nagar
entries.description: One of the specialty-coffee chain’s two Kochi branches. Local reporting describes a menu of specialty coffee, cold drinks and food.
entries.address: Ground Floor, 56/2988, H.I.G 36, Murikkummootil, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi

entries.name: Trouvaille
entries.description: This Princess Street café lists pour-over coffee alongside food and desserts. Check the current menu for the available brews.
entries.address: Princess Street, Fort Nagar, Fort Kochi, Kochi 682001
